name: YIELDMAT
description: YIELDMAT returns the yield to maturity for a security that pays all interest at maturity, such as a zero-coupon bond or certificate of deposit.
tldr: Calculates the annual yield of a security that pays interest at maturity.

basicExample.explanation: Calculates the yield for a security issued January 1, 2024, paying 6% interest at maturity, and priced at $98.

advancedExamples.title: With actual/365 basis
advancedExamples.explanation: Basis 3 counts actual days and uses a 365-day year.

howItWorks: YIELDMAT solves for the yield that equates the present value of the maturity payment, including accrued interest, to the current price.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

limitations: Issue date must be before maturity.

commonErrors.fix: Verify all inputs and date order.
Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: YIELDMAT works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between YIELDMAT and YIELD?
faq.answer: YIELDMAT is for securities that pay interest at maturity. YIELD is for periodic coupon bonds.

faq.question: When is YIELDMAT used?
faq.answer: It is used for zero-coupon bonds and certificates of deposit.
